payload.essential_definition_experimental: Sidik mean phenotype score < -2.0 (field-standard cutoff; validated on Sidik's own controls: 40/40 dispensable score>=-2, 36/40 essential score<-2)
payload.experimental_source: Sidik et al. 2016 Cell 167:1423 (DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2016.08.019) genome-wide CRISPR fitness screen; mean phenotype score, Suppl. mmc3.xlsx sheet 'Phenotype'; open Elsevier CDN 1-s2.0-S0092867416310704-mmc3.xlsx
payload.id_mapping: GEM TGME49_NNNNNN <-> screen TGGT1_NNNNNN by shared ToxoDB numeric locus suffix
payload.model_source: Krishnan et al. 2020 Cell Host & Microbe 27:290 (DOI 10.1016/j.chom.2020.01.002); via PARADIGM github.com/maureencarey/paradigm models/published/iTgo2020_krishnan.mat
payload.organism: Toxoplasma gondii (ME49 model gene IDs; screen in type I RH/GT1)

verdict: FBA gene-essentiality (iTgo2020, curated T. gondii GEM) vs EXPERIMENTAL essentiality (Sidik 2016 genome-wide CRISPR screen, mean phenotype < -2.0): over 550 mapped metabolic genes, OR 14.097 (one-sided hypergeometric p 7.672e-33), precision 0.843, recall 0.511, AUROC 0.725. Pre-registered gate (OR>3 AND p<0.01): PASS. Contingency {'both': 118, 'FBA_only': 22, 'exp_only': 113, 'neither': 297}. vs Plasmodium OR 2.469 (GENERALIZE5, FAIL): COMPLICATES the parasite conclusion (this parasite PASSES where Plasmodium failed). SCOPE: essentiality-enrichment only; in-silico vs published screen; curated model still a model; T. gondii is host-embedded so the default-medium GEM may be over-permissive (honest deployment risk).
